auth.title: Create your space
auth.description: Sign in so your birth details and future reflections stay connected to you.
auth.emailComingSoon: Email and password sign-in is coming next
auth.privacy: AstroCoach uses your account only to protect and save your experience.

birthData.title: When were you born?
birthData.description: Your birth date and time help us calculate the astronomical context used for your reflections.
birthData.dateHint: Use the date shown on your birth record.
birthData.timeUnknownLabel: I don’t know my birth time
birthData.unknownTimeExplanation: That’s completely okay. We can still use planetary placements, but we won’t calculate or interpret houses or angles without a reliable birth time.
birthData.saved: Your birth date and time preference have been saved.

errors.futureDate: Birth date cannot be in the future.
errors.requiredTime: Enter your birth time or select ‘I don’t know my birth time.’

birthLocation.back: Back to birth date and time
birthLocation.title: Where were you born?
birthLocation.description: Choose the city or town where you were born so we can place your chart accurately.
birthLocation.searchPlaceholder: Start typing a city or town
birthLocation.searchHint: Type at least two letters, then choose a result from the list.
birthLocation.noResults: No matching places found. Try a nearby city or a different spelling.
birthLocation.searchError: Location search is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
birthLocation.saved: Your birthplace has been saved and your initial chart is ready.

errors.required: Search for and select a birthplace from the list.
errors.service: We couldn’t verify that location right now. Please try again.

initialIntent.title: What brings you here?
initialIntent.description: Choose the areas that feel most relevant right now. This helps us begin with your lived experience, not assumptions.
initialIntent.contextLabel: What is happening in your life? (optional)
initialIntent.contextPlaceholder: Share as much or as little as feels useful…
initialIntent.contextHint: A recent situation, uncertainty, or recurring thought is a good place to start.
initialIntent.preparingDescription: We’re preparing your chart and combining it with what matters to you to find thoughtful places to begin.

errors.areas: Choose at least one area to continue.
errors.service: We couldn’t prepare your questions right now. Please try again.

initialDiscovery.title: A few places to begin
initialDiscovery.description: Take these one at a time. Your answers—not the chart—shape what we ask next.
initialDiscovery.serviceError: We couldn’t prepare the next step right now. Please try again.
initialDiscovery.completedDescription: Thank you. We now have enough lived context to begin exploring without treating your chart as a conclusion.

chartReview.title: Your starting chart
chartReview.description: Here is the astronomical chart calculated from the birth information you provided. This is context for exploration, not a conclusion about you.
chartReview.unknownTimeNote: Because your birth time is unknown, these positions use local noon as a reference. Houses, angles, nodes, and aspects are intentionally omitted.
chartReview.technical: Calculated locally with {engine}. Decimal longitude is shown to help verify the result.

onboarding.languageSavedDescription: Your language preference has been saved. We’ll use English throughout your experience.
onboarding.nextStep: Birth details are the next development slice.
